newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA TO BOOST BALTIC MARKET SHARE.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA TO BOOST BALTIC MARKET SHARE.

text.p: Kaija fish cannery said on Tuesday it aims to boost its 1997 profit by increasing its share of the Baltic market, adding a new processing line and improving its management and accountancy systems.
The company earlier announced audited 1996 profits of 639,893 lats versus a 1995 loss of 200,615 lats. It also forecast a 1997 profit of 1.1 million lats.
The company said it would also boost its business with new types of products and modern packaging.
Kaija in late 1996 was exporting produce worth some eight milion lats while the local market accounted for turnover worth 3.3 million lats.
Kaija said a new fish processing line would cost one million lats and it would be able to produce ISO 9000 quality.
Kaija plans further to improve its sales network and 100,000 lats would be spent on joint ventures in Russia and Belaru to boost sales there.
An improvement in the management and book-keeping system was also among its 1997 priorities.
